rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something diminishes the effect, value, or importance of something else.

example.english: This small flaw does detract from the appeal of the work.
example.traditional: 呢個小瑕疵的確減低咗件作品嘅吸引力。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu2 haa4 ci1 dik1 kok3 gaam2 dai1 zo2 gin6 zok3 ban2 ge3 kap1 jan5 lik6

rows.note: Use this for physically taking something away or removing it from a place.

example.english: Please take away that pile of junk by the door, or it will detract from the entrance.
example.traditional: 你快啲攞走門口嗰堆雜物，唔係會令入口失色。
example.jyutping: nei5 faai3 di1 lo2 zau2 mun4 hau2 go2 deoi1 zaap6 mat6 m4 hai6 wui6 ling6 jap6 hau2 sat1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when people, troops, equipment, or other resources are withdrawn from somewhere.

example.english: After the concert, the staff withdrew all the equipment so it would not detract from the audience’s ability to leave.
example.traditional: 演唱會完場後，工作人員就撤走所有器材，免得阻住觀眾離場。
